description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs line 46: The module-level doc example constructs DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains("Agency X Issuing CA".to_string()) — a mixed-case string. The doc for IssuerDnContains at line 222-224 explicitly states "The stored substring must be pre-lowercased. Passing an uppercase substring will not match anything." The example therefore demonstrates a deviation that silently never matches any certificate. This violates the API contract stated in the doc: the deviation would appear set up but would never fire. An operator following the example would deploy a permanently ineffective deviation with no error or warning. Fix: change the example to "agency x issuing ca".to_string() to match the lowercasing requirement.
title: P2: IssuerDnContains module doc example passes non-lowercased string (silent no-match)
